---
title: "Inspect individual sampling timing"
output: html_document
---

Inspect a participant-day against its registered and app-updated targets. Plot
colour represents compliance; marker shape represents whether an observed time
came from the app, manual diary, or schedule fallback.

```{r setup}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(collapse = TRUE, comment = "#>")
library(carwatch)

study_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "carwatch-gallery-individual-timing")
generate_synthetic_study_data(
  study_dir,
  n_participants = 4,
  non_compliant_sample_ratio = 0.20,
  missing_awakening_time_ratio = 0,
  missing_sampling_time_ratio = 0,
  random_state = 42,
  overwrite = TRUE
)

folders <- list.dirs(file.path(study_dir, "logs"), recursive = FALSE, full.names = TRUE)
participant_dirs <- stats::setNames(folders, basename(folders))
study_results <- convert_raw_logs(
  read_raw_logs_from_participant_dirs(participant_dirs),
  errors = "raise"
)
```

```{r select-day}
samples <- as_sample_events(study_results)
focus <- samples[samples$sample_compliant %in% FALSE, , drop = FALSE]
if (!nrow(focus)) focus <- samples
focus <- focus[1, c("participant", "day"), drop = FALSE]

day_samples <- samples[
  samples$participant == focus$participant[[1]] & samples$day == focus$day[[1]],
  ,
  drop = FALSE
]
day_samples[, c(
  "sample", "sample_position", "scheduled_sampling_time",
  "sampling_time", "time_deviation_min", "sample_compliant",
  "sampling_time_source"
)]
```

```{r timeline, fig.width=9, fig.height=5}
plot_sampling_timeline(
  study_results,
  participant = focus$participant[[1]],
  day = focus$day[[1]]
)
```

```{r interactive, eval=FALSE}
interactive_sampling_timeline(study_results)
```
